headline: Awarded $134,875 lead abatement contract at 85 Whipple St./136 Spring St. to RC Group, and snow plowing contracts for nine city locations.
summary: Approved a $33,810 change order for the Main St. Pump Station Improvements project. Awarded bids for lead abatement at 85 Whipple St./136 Spring St., contracted tree work, and snow plowing at nine locations. Also approved waivers of competition to buy a loader and a 6-wheel cab/chassis for Public Works.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 14, 2026 meeting, 5-0.
Approved Change Order #1 for the 2025-059 Main St. Pump Station Improvements with Ducas Construction, adding $33,810 and setting the contract amount at $1,384,810, 5-0.
Suspended the committee rule requiring at least two bids on contracts over $100,000 to consider RC Group’s bid 2026-050 as in the City’s best interest, 5-0.
Awarded bid 2026-050 for Lead Abatement of 85 Whipple St./136 Spring St. to RC Group at $134,875, including the $59,177.50 owner match, 5-0.
Ratified bid 2026-008 for EV Chargers Change Order #2 with Maine Solar Solutions, for a revised bid amount of $71,450, 5-0.
Authorized a waiver of competition with United Construction and Forestry to buy a loader with plow gear for Public Works at $457,731.56, including the extended warranty, 5-0.
Authorized a waiver of competition with Freightliner of Maine for a 6-wheel cab/chassis with sander, rack body, and plow gear for Public Works at $285,020, 5-0.
Ratified Change Order #2 for 2026-023 Continental Penstock and Upper Canal Repairs with Perryman Construction, totaling $7,480, with an updated estimated bid award of $657,875, 5-0.
Awarded bid 2026-053 for Contracted Tree Work to Maine Tree Guy of Auburn, ME, at $39,500, 5-0.

Awarded nine snow plowing and removal rental locations for bid 2026-052 for the 2026-27 winter season to Morin Excavating, C.H. Stevenson, and Campbell Investments at their proposed hourly rates, 5-0.

FINANCE COMMITTEE 
Lewiston, ME 
Minutes of  
September 28, 2026 
 
PRESENT: Chairman Chittim, Councilor Nagine, Mr. Bouh, Ms. McCabe, and Ms. Hoskins  
 
ABSENT: N/A 
 
OTHERS PRESENT: Deputy Director of Budget and Purchasing, Allen Ward , Deputy Public 
Works Deputy Director, Erica Kidd, City Engineer, Jeff Beaule, Fleet Operations Manager, Phil 
Brienza, City Arborist, Steve Murch, Facilities Manager, Louie Turcotte, and Assistant Economic 
Development Manager, Jaqueline Sawyer 
  
The meeting was called to order at 5:30 p.m.  
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(139-2026) To approve the minutes of the previous meeting dated September 14, 2026, and to 
accept and place them on file by the Clerk. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(140-2026) To approve the 2025-059 Main St. Pump Station Improvements, Change Order#1, 
adding $33,810 for two (2) months of backup generator rental costs to the project scope with Ducas 
Construction, and an updated contract amount of $1,384,810. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(141-2026) To suspend the Finance Committee’s rule requiring a minimum of two (2) bids on 
contracts in excess of $100,000 to consider RC Group’s 2026 -050 bid as being in the City’s best 
interest. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(142-2026) To award bid 2026-050 for the Lead Abatement of 85 Whipple St./136 Spring St. to 
RC Group, Biddeford, ME, at their amended bid price of $134,875, including the $59,177.50 
owner match.
FINANCE COMMITTEE                                                                             September 28, 2026 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(143-2026) To ratify bid 2026-008, Installation of EV Chargers, Change Order #2, adding $2,850 
to dismount and relocate the left -side charger unit and cabling at the Oak St. parking garage 
location into the scope of the project with Maine Solar Solutions, for a revised bid amount of 
$71,450, Lewiston’s portion being $14,290. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(144-2026) To authorize the Waiver of Competition with United Construction and Forestry for the 
purchase of a loader with plow gear for Public Works at their Sourcewell contract price of 
$457,731.56, including the extended warranty. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(145-2026) To authorize the Waiver of Competition with Freightliner of Maine for a 6 -wheel 
cab/chassis with a sander, rack body, and plow gear for Public Works at their Sourcewell contract 
price of $285,020. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(146-2026) To ratify 2026-023 Continental Penstock and Upper Canal Repairs, Change Order #2, 
for the additional total cubic yard cost for flowable fill for Penstock #4 to be included in the project 
scope with Perryman Construction for an estimated $110/CY, totaling $7,480, an d an updated 
estimated bid award of $657,875. 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Councilor Nagine, it was 
 
VOTED:  
(147-2026) To award bid 2026-053 for Contracted Tree Work to Maine Tree Guy, Auburn, ME, 
at their bid price of $39,500 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On Motion of Ms. Hoskins, seconded by Mr. Bouh, it was
FINANCE COMMITTEE                                                                             September 28, 2026 
 
VOTED:  
(148-2026) To award the nine (9) locations for bid 2026-052 Snow Plowing and Removal Rentals 
for the 2026-27 winter season as follows at their proposed hourly rates: 
 
1. Oak St. Parking Lots/Garage – Morin Excavating 
2. Lincoln St. Garage/Lot, Mill St. – Morin Excavating 
3. Southern Gateway Garage/Lots – C.H. Stevenson 
4. Canal St. Parking Garage – C.H. Stevenson 
5. Chestnut St. Parking Garage – C.H. Stevenson 
6. Police Station, 141 Mill St. – C.H. Stevenson 
7. Central Fire Station, 2 College St. – Morin Excavating 
8. Fire Substation #4, 55 N. Temple – Campbell Investments 
9. Fire Substation #5, Captain Bazinet Way – Campbell Investments 
 
 
VOTE: 5-0 
 
On motion of Mr. Bouh, seconded by Ms. Hoskins, 
 
VOTED: 
To adjourn at 6:29 p.m.     
 
              ___________________________________ 
                                      Allen Ward 
                                                                    Clerk  
        Finance Committee
